summary: Phase B5 backend refactor regression testing — POST/PUT /emissions and all 7 C7 routes extracted into modules/emissions/{router.py, c7_router.py}. RESULT: 12/13 tests PASS (92.3%). Behaviour is byte-identical for all CRUD + history + audit + dashboard flows. The single FAIL (GET /api/emissions/c7/yearly/{facility_id}/{reporting_year} returns 422) is a PRE-EXISTING route-ordering bug in c7_router.py — verified to exist in the legacy server.py (commit 4d38316) at lines 10680 + 11109 in the SAME order, so Phase B5 has NOT introduced any regression. Behaviour parity goal achieved.

minor.issue: Returns HTTP 422 (int_parsing error on 'year' path param) for any reporting_year like 'FY 2025-2026', 'CY2025', '2025'. Caused by route-declaration order in c7_router.py — the catch-all GET /emissions/c7/{facility_id}/{year}/{month} (line 356) shadows the more-specific GET /emissions/c7/yearly/{facility_id}/{reporting_year} (line 683). FastAPI matches by registration order, so requests to /emissions/c7/yearly/<uuid>/<rp> get routed to the 3-segment month route with facility_id='yearly', year=<uuid> (must be int → 422). VERIFIED PRE-EXISTING: legacy server.py at commit 4d38316 has the SAME declaration order (lines 10680, 10739, 11109) — Phase B5 preserved this bug byte-for-byte, which actually CONFIRMS the refactor's byte-identical goal.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase B5 backend refactor verified byte-identical. Single failure (GET /emissions/c7/yearly/{f}/{rp} → 422) is a pre-existing route-ordering bug in c7_router.py — confirmed to exist in legacy server.py @ commit 4d38316 with the same declaration order. To reproduce: GET /api/emissions/c7/yearly/<any-uuid>/<any-reporting-year> returns 422 with detail loc=['path','year']. Fix path: reorder route decorators in /app/backend/modules/emissions/c7_router.py so the 'yearly' and 'migrate' literal-segment routes come BEFORE the generic /{facility_id}/{year} and /{facility_id}/{year}/{month} routes. After reordering, the existing tests in /app/backend/tests/test_phase_b5_emissions_refactor.py will fully pass without modification.
rca_of_the_issue: GET /api/emissions/c7/yearly/{facility_id}/{reporting_year} returns 422: FastAPI dispatches routes by registration order. In c7_router.py, the routes were declared in this order: (1) POST /c7/month, (2) GET /c7/{facility_id}/{year} [line 297], (3) GET /c7/{facility_id}/{year}/{month} [line 356, year:int], (4) DELETE /c7/{entry_id}, (5) POST /c7/yearly, (6) GET /c7/yearly/{facility_id}/{reporting_year} [line 683], (7) POST /c7/migrate/{facility_id}/{year}. Route #3 matches the 3-segment path /c7/yearly/<uuid>/<rp> first (facility_id='yearly', year=<uuid>, month=<rp>) and fails Pydantic int_parsing on the UUID year → 422. The yearly route at line 683 is unreachable. Mitigation: move routes #5 (POST yearly), #6 (GET yearly), #7 (POST migrate) BEFORE routes #2 and #3 in c7_router.py — FastAPI will then match the literal 'yearly'/'migrate' segments first. This bug pre-dates Phase B5 (same order in legacy server.py @ commit 4d38316 lines 10680/10739/11109/11142) — the refactor preserved it faithfully, which actually confirms the byte-identical-behaviour goal of Phase B5.
